conceptual_change: Shift from price-based thresholds to a windowed rolling mean of VWAP distance. This captures transient deviations from the mean volume-weighted price, triggering a mean reversion when the distance compresses significantly below the 24-hour historical norm.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
